Manufacturing

Two manufacturing units of our own in India, backed by a network of 25+ audited partner plants.

Need a product we don't make in-house? Our partner network extends what we can offer, from multi-step synthesis to large-volume commodity production. Every partner is visited, audited and held to the same specification and documentation standard as our own units.

Discuss a custom product

How an order moves.

The same four steps whether you need a 1 kg sample or a regular monthly supply.

1

Share your specification

Product, CAS, purity, impurity limits, pack size and annual volume. Your spec sheet or a TDS is enough to start.

2

We make or match

If it suits our own units, we produce it. If a partner plant suits it better, we qualify that plant and remain responsible.

3

Samples and approval

Lab and pilot samples with COA, method of analysis and stability data, so your QA can approve the source quickly.

4

Commercial supply

Scale-up on the approved route, export paperwork handled, and every repeat batch held to the same specification.

Research and development

From a new specification to a reliable commercial process. Our chemists develop, optimise and scale the products you need, including ones that are not in our catalogue.

What our R&D team does.

Development work is planned with manufacturing in mind from day one, so a route that works in the lab also works at plant scale.

Custom synthesis

Intermediates, specialty chemicals and cosmetic actives made to your structure and specification, from grams to kilograms.

Route scouting and process development

We compare synthetic routes for yield, cost, safety and impurity profile, then optimise the chosen route for robust, repeatable output.

Scale-up and technology transfer

From lab to pilot to commercial batches on our own units or a qualified partner plant, with the same team managing the transfer.

Analytical support

Method development, impurity profiling and full characterisation, so every development batch ships with data your QA can rely on.

How a development project works.

Four clear stages, with a review point at the end of each one.

1

Share your requirement

Send the target product, CAS number or structure, specification and volume. We sign an NDA before any confidential detail is shared.

2

Feasibility and route design

Our chemists review possible routes, raw material availability, impurity risks and scalability, and propose a development plan.

3

Lab synthesis and characterisation

We make and refine the product at lab scale, confirm purity and impurity control, and send samples with a full COA.

4

Scale-up and supply

The validated process moves to pilot and commercial scale, with the specification locked so repeat batches match your approved sample.

Chemistry we work with.

  • Catalytic hydrogenation, including high-pressure reactions
  • Sodium metal and other air-sensitive reactions
  • Esterification and fractional distillation
  • Heterocyclic and carbazole chemistry for pharma intermediates
  • Resorcinol and cyclohexanedione chemistry
  • Purification by crystallisation and distillation

Chemistry outside our own units is developed with qualified partner labs and plants, under the same project team and confidentiality terms.

What you receive.

  • Development report with the chosen route and process conditions
  • Certificate of analysis and method of analysis for each batch
  • Impurity profile and stability data where required
  • Safety data sheet and technical data sheet
  • Batch records for scale-up and technology transfer

Your specifications, data and processes stay confidential. Ownership of project IP is agreed in writing before work begins.

Have a product in development?

Tell us the target, the specification and the volume you expect. A chemist will review it and reply with a development plan.

About Semzolve

A specialty chemicals manufacturer and supply partner from India, built to make chemical sourcing simpler, more reliable and more transparent for customers worldwide.

Our story.

Buying specialty chemicals often means dealing with many traders, uncertain quality and slow paperwork. Semzolve was started to change that, with one accountable team that takes responsibility from the first sample to the final shipment.

Today we run two manufacturing units of our own in India, which form the core of our production, and work with a network of 25+ audited partner plants. Together they cover more than 280 products across pharma and agro intermediates, specialty solvents, cosmetic ingredients, emulsions and industrial chemicals.

Our team combines chemistry, manufacturing and international trade experience, so customers in India and overseas get the right product, the right documents and dependable delivery.

2own manufacturing units
25+partner plants
280+products
15+export countries
Vision

To be the most trusted chemical partner from India for customers around the world.

Mission

To manufacture and supply quality chemicals reliably, through strong chemistry, transparent partnerships and responsible operations.

Our values.

The principles that guide how we make, test and deliver every product.

01

Quality without shortcuts

Every batch is tested and documented. If it does not meet the agreed specification, it does not leave.

02

Honest commitments

We quote lead times we can meet and tell customers early when something changes.

03

Customer first

We treat each customer's product, data and deadlines as if they were our own.

04

Safety and responsibility

We protect our people, our neighbours and the environment in every process we run.

05

Confidentiality

Specifications, processes and project data stay private, protected by NDAs and clear IP terms.

06

Always improving

We keep learning, investing in better chemistry and finding simpler ways to serve customers.
